**Finding submitted: deviation (medium severity, partial compliance).**

- **Renewal mechanics are already acceptable.** Section 11.1 provides one-year automatic renewals with a 30-day non-renewal notice exercisable by either party — this meets the preferred position on renewal term length and exit window, and is well inside the walk-away thresholds (the five-year initial term is not a renewal term).
- **Two preferred elements are missing.** There is no Commerce One reminder ahead of renewal, and no cap on renewal pricing: Exhibit B states only "Year 2-5, and beyond: [*]" (p0153–p0154) and Section 4 (Fees) contains no uplift limitation, leaving renewal-term increases unconstrained.
- **Redline (validated ok:true).** A single appended sentence pair in 11.1 adds a 60-day advance renewal notice from Commerce One and caps renewal fee increases at the lesser of CPI and 3%, with a 5% fallback flagged in the comment.
